body.x: Izzi Gadgets(www.izzigadgets.com) showcased Izzi ORBIT Pro at 'Showstoppers' of the '2014 International CES', the biggest IT∙appliances show that is being held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.
The company explains "The iZZi Orbit combines the ingenuity of a Peripheral Motion Lock Technology (PMLT) integrated with three interchangeable lens options(fish-eye, telephoto, wide-angle)."
According to company, the Slim iPhone case is made from durable polycarbonate material, it will fit into iPhone 5/5S easily just like a glove.

'CES(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500~3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
